These are new meshes with self-shading, not a lighting/color change, so the bounded facade-relief gap is addressed. drive.png (t15.5) shows no blocking regression: the trace confirms the vehicle still reaches the pad (closest driving approach 0.68 m, delivery at Z24.9, mission_complete) and all walk/world/motor/courier/combat regression tests pass; the frame's crowding is a composition/marker-clipping flaw, not a route blockage. Acceptance is bounded: this fixes the blank wall, not the overall Chicago fidelity, and two stated acceptance items (stoop, readable cornice) are still not visible in the like-for-like after.png frame.
